name: [NOW🎃] Grow An Egg
desc:
🐔 Welcome to Grow an Egg Simulator ! 🐔

💰 Purchase eggs from the Egg Shop!
🎉 Place your eggs on your tycoon farm and watch it grow over time! even when you're offline 😴
🐱 Hatch your egg and collect the pets 🐶
💵 Sell the pets for coins to buy rarer eggs 🦖
🐣 Put your pets in the nest and wait for it to lay eggs 🐣
🌈 Buy seeds from the shop to mutate your eggs for super rare & valuable! 💎

✨ Everything grows while you're offline. Just chill & have fun and come back later! 😎📱
